closed_hostile_findings: a single installed native worker could previously authorize an incomplete graph; activation now requires the exact immutable participant, input and configuration manifests
native recovery/control hooks could be absent when a run activated; activation and reconciliation now require the complete regional schema, sealed topology and exact enabled storage guards
execution mode could previously be inferred from mutable runtime rows; each run now freezes immutable NATIVE_JOIN or LEGACY_SOURCE authority
a source consumer could previously make a routed legacy topology appear executable; LEGACY_SOURCE now rejects every declared participant input outside the exact source manifest

source publication and control admission could diverge across process loss; the accepted record and PUBLISHED witness now commit atomically, with bounded retirement and an explicit idempotency horizon

drain could miss ordered barriers, active recovery or a partial operator graph; the fixed point now covers DATA cursors, ordered-log scan, invocations, blocked inputs, checkpoint lifecycle and global/regional recovery
cancellation could leave a valid old worker or recovery generation able to publish; durable storage guards fence legacy, native and regional terminal/progress paths
source-only ownership allowed cross-tenant output mixing; deployment activation now claims every source, intermediate and leaf output partition with an immutable role
explicit_limits: protocol schema installation and direct database credentials remain a trusted provisioning boundary; DS-051c must enforce production worker credentials and DDL isolation
LEGACY_SOURCE supports only the exact installed source-consumer manifest and no routed participant input; NATIVE_JOIN requires full R3 bootstrap before activation
the prototype supports one revision-bound control run and one structured producer per owned source partition
a cancelled unprocessed suffix remains pinned until a separately specified discard policy; it is not treated as completed
logical row/JSON-byte census does not measure PostgreSQL heap, indexes, WAL, vacuum or the later soak gate
Prefect integration, production IAM and transport deployment, upgrades, infrastructure chaos and the 72-hour soak remain later gates
phase: R4-A independent ETL Architect / HighLoad Principal gate review

DS-040a.basis: actual-socket run/partition/operator/input/barrier/recovery/pressure projections match an independent read-only PostgreSQL oracle, including fresh-server process-loss continuity

DS-040b.basis: database-time control leader leases, locked epoch validation, stale-writer rejection, takeover and durable exact command retry after a lost HTTP response

DS-040c.basis: deployment/run lifecycle, atomic bounded source admission/publication, true DAG drain fixed point, legacy/native/regional cancellation fencing and 100-cycle credit-return census

DS-040d.basis: in-transaction capability revalidation, revocation/expiry/role controls, cross-tenant denial and exclusive role-bound ownership of all revision source/output partitions
